name: Aoyama
source: One of the characters of the Correctness storyline. He is a detective in the Heinous Crimes Unit. Mostly works alongside Akama. [spoiler]He is ultimately revealed to be part of a bizarre conspiracy surrounding the Heinous Crimes Unit.[/spoiler]
